name: Dalis
source:
“Then just talk normally. My ears get all itchy otherwise.”

Vice-Captain of the Meisa Knights.
Laid-back and approachable, he puts up no barriers with anyone, even addressing the Holy Maiden as “lass.”
Though he often seems carefree to the point of negligence, beneath the surface he harbors a burning determination that few ever see.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url].]
